name: fintrack
description: FINTRACK — controle financeiro pessoal (Web + Android + API)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fintrack/api" "npm run dev -w @fintrack/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @fintrack/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @fintrack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
